change_summary: Ran a runtime-only monkeypatch of `signal_engine.generate_signals()` and `portfolio_engine.size_signals()` so breakout candidates carried four participation-state fields and then screened five graduated deployment shapes across the deterministic late / mid / old OHLCV snapshots. The screened family stayed inside the same mechanism class as `exp-20260423-002`: only breakout risk budget changed, while entries, exits, ranking, and the accepted cohort rules stayed unchanged. No repository trading logic was kept after measurement.
component: runtime-only monkeypatch of `quant/signal_engine.py` + `quant/portfolio_engine.py` sizing path (rolled back; no repo trading logic changed)

delta_metrics.note: Graduated deployment improved the weaker windows again, and adding `breakout_breadth` modestly sharpened the mid/old-window rescue. But no screened variant improved the primary late-strong window enough to clear Gate 4: the best primary-safe version stayed a strict null in the late window, while the most effective weak-window rescue regressed the late window. The blocker is therefore no longer 'binary vs graduated'; it is the lack of current-window evidence for this mechanism on present data.

hypothesis: If `exp-20260423-002` was primary-window null because the deployment shape was too binary, then a richer version of the same forward-looking participation-state breakout-health mechanism should work better: attach whole-universe `above200_breadth`, `positive_momentum_breadth`, `breakout_breadth`, and `breadth_gap` to each breakout candidate, then replace the binary haircut with graduated sizing tiers. A real improvement should keep the weak-window rescue while finally producing present-tense value in the late strong window.
next_retry_requires: Do not keep permuting graduated sizing tiers inside the same whole-universe narrow-leadership family by default

If this branch is revisited, require either fresh forward data that creates a real primary-window test of the state, or a genuinely different participation proxy within the same mechanism family instead of another deployment-shape sweep
Prefer another unblocked alpha branch over more `binary vs graduated` breakout-health tuning unless new present-tense evidence appears
notes: This remained a single-causal-variable experiment: only the deployment shape of the forward-looking participation-state breakout haircut changed. The result tightens the doctrine from `exp-20260423-002`: the mechanism remains promising for weaker eras, but graduated deployment alone is not enough to promote it into repo trading logic.
rejection_reason: Rejected on Gate 4 promotion criteria. The mechanism family still cannot show present-tense value in the current dominant window: the strongest majority-window shapes remained late-window null, and the versions that pushed the weak-window rescue further began to tax the late strong window. This is a clean negative result for deployment-shape tuning inside the same participation-state family, not a data-availability blocker.
